decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development is consistent with the character of the original dwellinghouse and will not have any adverse impacts upon the existing amenity of the adjoining properties or street scene. The proposal is thus considered to be generally consistent with the provisions of Policy ENV - B.1.1 (New Development) and Policy - H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and Section 1 of the Residential Extension Guidelines. Where the proposal does not comply it is considered that there will be no undue adverse affects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the western elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
